Question B-001-016-011.

Why the correct answer is right: Single sideband on 10.12 MHz falls inside the 10.100 MHz to 10.150 MHz band where SSB is specifically prohibited.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Frequency modulation (FM) on 29.6 MHz": At 29.6 MHz, FM falls in the 10-metre 20 kHz category, and the FM bandwidth cue fits that allowance.
- sourceIndex 2: "Morse radiotelegraphy (CW) on 10.11 MHz": CW is a narrow keyed mode, so it fits the narrow 10.100 MHz to 10.150 MHz context in a way SSB does not.
- sourceIndex 3: "FT8 on 10.136 MHz": FT8 is a narrow digital mode; the SSB prohibition applies to single sideband in the 10.100 MHz to 10.150 MHz band.
